Tuesday Bakery Easy Ride

Davis, CA · West Davis

Beginner friendly

Tuesday Bakery Easy Ride is a road group ride in Davis, CA. It meets every Tuesday, 9:00 am (8:00 am late May through mid-September), starting at Westlake Plaza parking lot. Expect about 26 miles, 12–14 mph.

About the Tuesday Bakery Easy Ride group ride

Also called the Tuesday Dixon Donut Ride. A casual 26-mile ride through farm country to Dixon with a stop at Solano Bakery. Pace is 12 to 14 mph. Winds over 20 mph cancel it. Helmets required; guests can ride once before joining the club.
